{
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "app/models/topic_embed.rb",
      "line": 22,
      "severity": "critical",
      "category": "security",
      "title": "Raw HTML imported from feeds is rendered without sanitization (stored XSS)",
      "body": "TopicEmbed.import creates the post with cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html] using the caller-supplied contents as raw. PollFeed passes i.content from the RSS feed directly after only unescaping/scrubbing, with no sanitizer. Because Post#cook returns raw for raw_html, embed/best.html.erb then outputs post.cooked with `raw`. Script tags in a feed item are therefore stored and executed in the Discourse-origin embed iframe. This is a stored XSS vector for any untrusted or compromised feed."
    },
    {
      "file": "app/views/embed/best.html.erb",
      "line": 6,
      "severity": "high",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Invalid ERB tag `<%- end if %>` prevents the template from compiling",
      "body": "The first if/else block is closed with `<%- end if %>` instead of `<%- end %>`. ERB treats everything inside the tag as Ruby code, and `end if` is a syntax error. Whenever this template is rendered, ERB compilation raises SyntaxError, so the embedded discussion view is unusable."
    },
    {
      "file": "app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb",
      "line": 31,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "PollFeed assumes rss.items is always present",
      "body": "`rss.items.each` is called without checking whether `rss.items` is nil. SimpleRSS.parse can return nil or an object with nil `items` for empty/malformed feeds, causing NoMethodError and aborting the entire scheduled poll. The job should guard `rss.items.present?` before iteration."
    },
    {
      "file": "app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb",
      "line": 35,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "bug",
      "title": "Missing `content` field crashes the feed poll",
      "body": "`i.content.scrub` is called without checking that `i.content` is present. RSS/Atom items frequently provide only `description` or `summary`, in which case `nil.scrub` raises NoMethodError and the entire poll job fails. Use `(i.content || i.description || i.summary).to_s.scrub` or otherwise handle missing content."
    },
    {
      "file": "app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb",
      "line": 11,
      "severity": "medium",
      "category": "security",
      "title": "request.referer is interpolated into JavaScript without escaping",
      "body": "The postMessage target origin uses `'<%= request.referer %>'` directly inside a JavaScript string. The Referer header is browser-supplied and the embedding page URL is not necessarily trusted to be JS-safe; a URL path containing a single quote can break out of the string and execute script in the Discourse-origin iframe. Escape it for JavaScript (or otherwise encode it) before inclusion."
    },
    {
      "file": "app/models/topic_embed.rb",
      "line": 20,
      "severity": "low",
      "category": "concurrency",
      "title": "Race condition can cause duplicate TopicEmbed insert and job failure",
      "body": "TopicEmbed.import checks `TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first` outside the transaction and later relies on a unique index when creating the row. Two concurrent RetrieveTopic/PollFeed jobs for the same missing URL can both see no embed and both attempt the insert; the second will raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique instead of reusing the existing record. Add a unique-index rescue or an atomic insert/check to handle concurrent imports gracefully."
    }
  ]
}

findings.title: Raw HTML imported from feeds is rendered without sanitization (stored XSS)
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import creates the post with cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html] using the caller-supplied contents as raw. PollFeed passes i.content from the RSS feed directly after only unescaping/scrubbing, with no sanitizer. Because Post#cook returns raw for raw_html, embed/best.html.erb then outputs post.cooked with `raw`. Script tags in a feed item are therefore stored and executed in the Discourse-origin embed iframe. This is a stored XSS vector for any untrusted or compromised feed.

findings.title: Invalid ERB tag `<%- end if %>` prevents the template from compiling
findings.body: The first if/else block is closed with `<%- end if %>` instead of `<%- end %>`. ERB treats everything inside the tag as Ruby code, and `end if` is a syntax error. Whenever this template is rendered, ERB compilation raises SyntaxError, so the embedded discussion view is unusable.

findings.title: PollFeed assumes rss.items is always present
findings.body: `rss.items.each` is called without checking whether `rss.items` is nil. SimpleRSS.parse can return nil or an object with nil `items` for empty/malformed feeds, causing NoMethodError and aborting the entire scheduled poll. The job should guard `rss.items.present?` before iteration.

findings.title: Missing `content` field crashes the feed poll
findings.body: `i.content.scrub` is called without checking that `i.content` is present. RSS/Atom items frequently provide only `description` or `summary`, in which case `nil.scrub` raises NoMethodError and the entire poll job fails. Use `(i.content || i.description || i.summary).to_s.scrub` or otherwise handle missing content.

findings.title: request.referer is interpolated into JavaScript without escaping
findings.body: The postMessage target origin uses `'<%= request.referer %>'` directly inside a JavaScript string. The Referer header is browser-supplied and the embedding page URL is not necessarily trusted to be JS-safe; a URL path containing a single quote can break out of the string and execute script in the Discourse-origin iframe. Escape it for JavaScript (or otherwise encode it) before inclusion.

findings.title: Race condition can cause duplicate TopicEmbed insert and job failure
findings.body: TopicEmbed.import checks `TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first` outside the transaction and later relies on a unique index when creating the row. Two concurrent RetrieveTopic/PollFeed jobs for the same missing URL can both see no embed and both attempt the insert; the second will raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique instead of reusing the existing record. Add a unique-index rescue or an atomic insert/check to handle concurrent imports gracefully.
